meta.name: scienceworld-ambiguous-action-resolution
meta.description: Use when the ScienceWorld environment returns an "Ambiguous request" prompt with a numbered list of identical action options. This skill resolves the disambiguation by selecting the lowest available number (typically 0) to proceed, ensuring task progression when multiple identical object instances exist and the system cannot automatically determine which instance to act upon.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动选择最低编号解决歧义请求
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在ScienceWorld中自动处理歧义动作选择。
copy.tagline_en: Automatically select lowest number to resolve ambiguous requests
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automatically handle ambiguous action choices in ScienceWorld.

howto.what: 装上后，当 ScienceWorld 环境返回“歧义请求”并列出相同选项时，Claude 会自动选择列表中的第一个选项（数字 0）来继续任务。
howto.when: 当环境提示包含“Ambiguous request: Please enter the number for the action you intended (or blank to cancel):”，且选项是相同的对象实例时触发。

say.note: 适用于多个相同对象场景。

howto.what_en: When the ScienceWorld environment returns an "Ambiguous request" with identical options, Claude automatically selects the first option (number 0) to proceed.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the environment shows "Ambiguous request: Please enter the number for the action you intended (or blank to cancel):" with functionally identical options.

say_en.text: Use the first option to continue
